description: Full body chibi anime pixel art game sprite, 16-year-old young woman adventurer facing the viewer, standing straight, arms relaxed at sides, empty hands. Long chestnut-brown hair in a high ponytail with side bangs, warm amber eyes, friendly determined face. Simple beginner outfit: off-white linen blouse, laced brown leather bodice vest, dark green scarf, leather belt with small pouch, short dark brown skirt over black leggings, brown leather boots, fingerless leather gloves.

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the drawing style: chibi anime proportions (big head, big eyes), crisp black pixel outline, shading and detail level. Do NOT copy the colors, hair or clothing — the new character must look like a different person.
